title: PlayingInTheMUD
tagline: Just exploring and learning about Autonomous Worlds and MUD over the weekend.
how_its_made:
I worked through the documentation and followed along with the hackathon presentations to get a better understanding of how this framework works.
Using the provided Phaser template, I was able to replace the sprites, and tile maps as well as start creating a UI
I started working on a system to get entities to move from one position to another using  block number as a way to interpolate the time. 
My goal was to show the entity moving on the client in a smooth way and it's still a work in progress.
